subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streams treat `timeoutSeconds` as an idle/no-progress timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling stream transports, once remote-run proof is added?
rationale: The code path looks narrow and consistent with sibling transports, but changing an existing provider timeout from wall-clock to progress-refreshed behavior is an upgrade-sensitive compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept idle-timeout parity after proof
options.body: Require redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then allow native Ollama streams to match the sibling stream timeout contract.

options.title: Keep wall-clock timeout semantics
options.body: Ask for a different fix if maintainers want `timeoutSeconds` to remain a hard total cap for native Ollama streams.

recommendation.title: Accept idle-timeout parity after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then allow native Ollama streams to match the sibling stream timeout contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Ollama stream work and current-main blame make this the strongest routing candidate for the timeout semantics decision.
